title: The Battle Plan
description: Mon Mothma was joined by Admiral Ackbar as they and a command center full of Rebels listened intently to the Alliance's latest plan of attack, this one designed to obliterate the Empire's second Death Star. Two phases of the operation were revealed: first: the battle station's shield generators on the forest moon of Endor needed to be taken out by a Rebel strike force, and second, the massive Alliance fleet would engage and finally destroy the unprotected Death Star in a major space battle.
